verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state traces can be filtered, exported, shared, and compared via UI or API, and SDKs (Python/TS/Go/Java) support tracing, datasets, and evaluation programmatically. However, alerts, dashboards, and annotation queues are described only in UI terms with no documented API/CLI equivalents, and no public OpenAPI spec was found (all candidate URLs 404), suggesting incomplete API parity for configuration-heavy features.
